name: Motor mount plate
reason: Base part - the boom clamp, motor and ESC all mount to it.

name: Boom clamp, upper half
reason: Must be separate so the boom tube can be fitted into the clamp.

name: Boom clamp, lower half
reason: Same material as the plate, does not move, nothing is fitted between the two.

name: M4 x 20 cap screw (clamp)
reason: Standard fastener clamping the arm to the boom.

name: VTOL lift motor, 505-class
reason: Rotating machine - the whole point of the arm.

name: M3 x 8 cap screw (motor)
reason: Standard fastener holding the motor to the plate.

name: ESC and lead set
reason: Built and tested on the bench, fitted to the arm as one unit.

name: ESC, 60 A
reason: Electronic assembly - must be electrically isolated from the structure.

name: Motor lead harness, 3 core
reason: Flexible conductor - cannot be integral with either end.

name: Cable tie, 150 mm
reason: Holds the ESC against the boom.

name: Apply threadlocker - clamp and motor screws
Heatshrink and label the lead set
